experimental_method: Direct sampling of the equilibrated liquid phase from a stirred stainless-steel cell at high temperature; dissolved gas determined by freezing the solvent out and measuring the gas in a gas burette.
uncertainties_stated: Temperature within 0.1 K; pressure within 0.5%; reproducibility in x better than 0.5%; overall precision in Henry constants 1-2% (up to ~20% at 600 K).
quality_remarks: kH values are reliable to experimental error up to about 520 K; above ~520 K third and higher virial terms make kH uncertain. Authors report 20% discrepancy with Potter and Clyne (1978). Ar-D2O row at 536.9 K has y=0.4092 which is non-monotonic in the series (printed as is). Xe above 470 K limited by clathrate formation in cold part of the line.
not_extracted_tables: Table II (fit coefficients of ln kH, model parameters)
Table III (derived thermodynamic functions at three temperatures)
